notes: «جميعا عن» converges Amr and Zuhayr on Ibn Uyayna: one level of two co-transmitters
The dash gloss «- قال زهير حدثنا سفيان بن عيينة -» repeats the same shaykh: a version gloss, left out
«يبلغ به النبي» carries the report up to the Prophet, who is not a link; «أبيه» is Salim's father, named only by relation
